test.template: Run the full test suite: `source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/ -v`. Report any failures and suggest fixes.

lint.template: Run ruff linter: `source .venv/bin/activate && ruff check src/ tests/`. Fix any issues found.

format-check.template: Check formatting: `source .venv/bin/activate && ruff format --check src/ tests/`. Report any unformatted files.
format-check.description: Check if code is properly formatted

build.template: Build the macOS app: `source .venv/bin/activate && python setup.py py2app`. Report build output and any issues.
